findings.reason: the plan either narrows the change to the node_id mint while leaving source_node the node id, or states and tests the repair-node-id consequence; as written a builder ships an unmeasured behavior change to repair dispatch for paired arms, and a reader hitting a mismatched or duplicated repair round would have no way to trace it to this edit.
findings.text: the remedy sets source_node to the run id for a paired arm, but source_node is not only the node_id input: recovery_repair_dispatch.py:665 passes fields["source_node"] into compose_repair_for_run, which forwards it to compose_repair_node and repair_node_id (repair.py:492), so a repair of a paired arm's review mints a different repair node id (repair-of-r-…-<head> instead of repair-of-<node-id>-<head>) with no line in the plan stating that consequence and no test in the gate list covering repair dispatch

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — every cited anchor resolves in the tree: recovery_review_subject.py:460 (_review_dispatch_fields) and :608 (source_node from node id), promotion_checks.py:606 (_paired_partner_run_id, resolves both sides), dispatch_admission.py:1866 (_reviewed_run_id_for_node) and :1883 (_review_record_directory_grant), recovery_review_delivery.py:156 and its first-match loop at :172-174, dispatch_sessions.py:457 (_reviewed_run_id, newest match); the cited arms r-20261018T063236394668 and r-20261018T063236394831 both live and both carry node id efit-field-swap, one with paired_shadow_run_id and the other a shadow lineage naming its primary.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — the three bullets are measurable (minted node ids and resolver returns asserted by a new test, pytest delta over a named file list, ruff delta against base blobs) and the section declares a negative control of two mutations, each firing a named case.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the gate writes its pytest and ruff output on disk and the new test points the crew home at a temporary directory, so no evidence or state lands in a session scratchpad or node-local path.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the section heading and the new test filename carry a descriptive slug, not a plan label, ticket number or version tag, and no stage identifier reaches a symbol.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — the stated root cause matches the cited evidence and the mechanism does reach the real path (the printed command's --node is fields["node_id"], minted by round_node_id at recovery_review_subject.py:666, and dispatch resolves it through _reviewed_run_id_for_node at dispatch_admission.py:1820), but remedy part 1 also changes the returned source_node field, which has a second consumer the plan does not name.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §1 names one deliverable: a paired arm's review is scoped to its own run, delivered as two edits that both serve that outcome.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — the plan declares no depends-on/informs/gates and its plan-standalone meta justifies that (it repairs the landed paired dispatch of a-shadow-cannot-see-its-primary, no live plan waits on it); the sibling pair plans (a-pair-never-runs-its-arms-alike, a-paired-shadow-runs-on-its-named-backend) touch none of this plan's three write paths, so no needed relationship is missing.
